thesis: The episode introduces Anchorage Digital as an institutional platform founded in 2017 to address the lack of operational security in key management among sophisticated investors. The founders, Diogo Monica and Nathan McCulley, built the company after seven years of working together on security teams at Square and Docker, initially responding to a request from a fund that had lost a $1.5 million Bitcoin wallet passphrase.
